requirements.title: Check local outcomes and durable completion independently

scenarios: Outcome authority for local and remote legs
properties.statement: The actual outcome authorizes exactly the matching application.
properties.oracle: Placed and remote effects match the decision on nine exhaustively checked graphs. The held-only cash payout after ABORT and the omitted local transfer violate the new assertion.

scenarios: Evidenced COMMIT report and retained financial row
properties.statement: The COMMIT projection and L04 endpoint preserve an exact evidenced result.
properties.oracle: The previous progress formula entails an evidenced booking using its same checked graphs and fairness. A missing application proof and a premature row surviving cache loss each violate the independent assertion.

properties.statement: The actual prior transaction determines admission and terminal immutability.
properties.oracle: The observation covers every reachable state of the A-hosted named preparation and decision spine. The eligibility-omission and tombstone-reopen producers each have a native counterexample.

scenarios: Pending obligations survive governance and intervention
properties.statement: An accepted trade can complete under recorded recovery conditions.
properties.oracle: Old authorized settlement survives rotation, exit, freeze, proof retry, and cache loss. The same prefixes deny unsupported proof programs, new old-epoch signing, unresolved freezes and duplicate payment.

properties.statement: Exact evidence determines the durable SQLite row.
properties.oracle: A restored old physical database file rebuilds one durable row from both retained application results. Partial, wrong-phase and differently bound events create no completed row.
